policy: Separate from the completed ZIP research queue. New behavioral evidence requires an expressly authorized disposable-session test. Offline work may use synthetic data and already-sanctioned aggregate results.

tasks.title: Identity token census
tasks.acceptance: Classify generic chat and message identity syntax from saved files.

tasks.title: Parent and edge syntax
tasks.acceptance: Count graph-related property co-occurrence without claiming a concrete message schema.

tasks.title: Branch and stream source signatures
tasks.acceptance: Identify generic branch and streaming syntax in common function scopes.

tasks.title: Inspect captured chat controls
tasks.acceptance: Locate sanitized edit, regeneration, composer and new-chat affordances in the saved DOM with closest semantic regions.

tasks.title: Define neutral message graph
tasks.acceptance: Implement synthetic conversation/message/attempt identities, parent edges, selection and branch rules.

tasks.title: Test message graph invariants
tasks.acceptance: Test cycles, missing parents, selected leaves, branch conservation and ambiguous attempts.

tasks.title: Implement generic event graph adapter
tasks.acceptance: Expose stable machine-qualified transitions; refuse live execution of hypothesis edges.

tasks.title: Browse evidence and feature backlog
tasks.acceptance: Expose source signatures and next research tasks in the Chat interactions chapter.

tasks.title: Define safe structural trace format
tasks.acceptance: Design event-class, timestamp, structure-delta and provenance schema with no sensitive values.

tasks.title: Observe selection and navigation
tasks.acceptance: Document selection state changes in a separate authorized synthetic test session.

tasks.title: Observe draft and submit
tasks.acceptance: Correlate synthetic submit action with generic UI status changes.

tasks.title: Observe streaming and stop
tasks.acceptance: Establish actual response start, streaming, stop and completion order.

tasks.title: Observe edits and regeneration
tasks.acceptance: Determine whether changes mutate nodes or introduce alternate nodes.

tasks.title: Observe branch to new chat
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish conversation forks from alternative replies and document visible ancestry.

tasks.title: Observe persistence boundaries
tasks.acceptance: Test what survives reload and tab changes without collecting storage values.

tasks.title: Observe failures and retries
tasks.acceptance: Verify error and retry lifecycle without inducing destructive actions.

tasks.title: Classify request-to-UI correspondence
tasks.acceptance: Correlate abstract event categories only; no URLs, headers, bodies or identifiers.

tasks.title: Research externally documented exported chat trees
tasks.acceptance: Separate public export-format evidence from the saved ZIP, implement a local-only incremental JSON analyzer, and test branching and selected-node path reconstruction with synthetic data.
